descripcion_geo: Ancient kingdom east of Mesopotamia (modern Khuzestan, Iran), with capital at Susa. One of the oldest powers in the Middle East.
importancia_estrategica: Power that captured Lot in the times of Abraham and was later conquered by the Assyrians; scenario from Daniel's book.

historias.titulo: Chedorlaomer king of Elam captures Lot
historias.descripcion: The Elamite king Chedorlaomer leads a coalition of kings that captures Lot in Sodom; Abraham rescues him with 318 men.

historias.titulo: Susa of Elam: scene of Esther and Daniel
historias.descripcion: The capital of Elam, Susa, became the capital of the Persians; The books of Esther and part of Daniel take place there.
Among those present at Pentecost who heard the gospel are Elamites from the ancient region of Elam.

personajes.descripcion: Leader of the first war recorded in the Bible; defeated by Abraham.
He had a vision of the ram and the goat by the river Ulai in Susa of Elam.
He defeated the king of Elam and rescued his nephew Lot with only 318 men.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Elam: relevant geographic region in the Old Testament.

mitos.nombre: The first war of the Bible

judaismo.descripcion: The Elamite coalition that captured Lot is the first war narrated in the OT; Abraham won it with a tiny troop, a sign of God's power.
judaismo.significado_teologico: The Elamite coalition that captured Lot is the first war narrated in the OT; Abraham won it with a tiny troop, a sign of God's power.

cristianismo.descripcion: The Elamites heard the gospel at Pentecost (Acts 2:9): the gospel reaches even to the land of Abraham's first enemies.
